Lina (Finance): Operator Labs says April invoice shows 1,050,000 embeddings but their internal logs show 1,280,000. They want a line-level reconciliation + credits if we overbilled. Ticket: https://go/recon/T-2122
Omar (Data): pulling raw vs deduped from embeddings_topic. running two quick queries now.
Nina (Eng): note: on 2026-04-28 22:40 UTC we had a partition leader fail and consumer group recovered; offsets were momentarily reset for partition-2. Could cause replays for ~6m.
Jules (Billing): our billing uses billing_view (deduped by request_id). if duplicates slipped through billing_view ingestion window we'd bill extra. Need the data numbers.
Omar (Data): raw_count=1,279,842; deduped_count=1,049,921; delta=229,921.
Lina (Finance): estimated impact at Operator tier ($0.00038/embedding) -> 229,921 * 0.00038 = $87.37. Confirm exact after audit bundle.
Jules (Billing): next steps: 1) dry-run backfill to compute definitive billed_delta; 2) produce audit bundle (raw events, dedupe logs, consumer offsets); 3) Finance+Legal sign-off for credit memo.
Nina (Eng): I'll capture consumer rehab logs and open a short PR to add stronger offset checkpointing.
Omar (Data): sample backfill SQL attached to ticket. I'll run dry-run tonight in low-traffic window and upload results to T-2122.
Lina (Finance): Approved to run dry-run and prepare numbers + a customer-friendly note.
recon-bot: Invoice OP-2026-04 flagged 'under review' by Lina (Finance)
